- `COUNT` = `r COUNT` controls whether the read-counting step using `featureCounts` is performed and is set to `FALSE` by default.


## `featureCounts`


```{r featureCounts, results="verbatim"}
# Counts
feat_saf = feat[, c(4,1:3, 6)]
# feat_saf = feat[1:100,c(4,1:3, 6)]
colnames(feat_saf) = c("GeneID", "Chr", "Start", "End", "Strand")
feat_saf$Start = as.numeric(feat_saf$Start)
feat_saf$End   = as.numeric(feat_saf$End  )
saf_filename = paste0(prefix, ".saf")
options(scipen=999)
write.table(feat_saf, file=saf_filename, sep="\t", quote=FALSE,row.names=FALSE, col.names=FALSE)
options(scipen=0)

cmd = "featureCounts"
mmq = 30
if (sr_or_pe=="PE") {
  opt_pe="-p --countReadPairs -B -C -O "
} else {
  opt_pe=" "  
}
args = paste0(
  " ", opt_pe, " -a ", saf_filename, " -F SAF -s 0 -Q ", mmq, " -T 32 -o ", prefix, "_count.txt ", 
  paste0(e$bam , " ", collapse=" "),
  ""
)
print(paste(cmd, args))
if (COUNT) {system2(cmd, args)}
```




##  Raw counts


```{r raw_counts, fig.height=3, results="verbatim"}
raw_counts_summary = read.table(paste0(prefix, "_count.txt.summary"), header=TRUE, row.names=1)
colnames(raw_counts_summary) = sub(paste0(".*", gse, "\\.([^.]+)_end\\.to\\.end.*"), "\\1", colnames(raw_counts_summary))
raw_counts_summary = raw_counts_summary[!apply(raw_counts_summary==0, 1, all),]
layout(matrix(1:3, 1), respect=TRUE)
cols = c(
  "#E63946",  # rouge
  "#F4A261",  # orange
  "#E9C46A",  # jaune
  "#2A9D8F",  # vert/bleu
  "#457B9D",  # bleu
  "#6D597A",  # violet
  "#B56576",  # vieux rose
  "#588157"   # vert
)
barplot(col=cols, as.matrix(raw_counts_summary), las=2)
barplot(col=cols, prop.table(as.matrix(raw_counts_summary), margin=2), las=2)
plot.new()
legend("topleft", legend=rownames(raw_counts_summary), fill=cols, bty="n")

raw_counts = read.table(paste0(prefix, "_count.txt"), header=TRUE)
rownames(raw_counts) = raw_counts[,1]
pf = raw_counts[,c(2, 3, 4, 1, 6, 5)]
names(pf) = c("chr", "start", "end", "name", "score","strand")
raw_counts = as.matrix(raw_counts[,-(1:6)])
colnames(raw_counts) = sub(paste0(".*", gse, "\\.([^.]+)_end\\.to\\.end.*"), "\\1", colnames(raw_counts))
head(raw_counts[,1:3])
tail(raw_counts[,1:3])
dim( raw_counts)

saveRDS(raw_counts, paste0("datashare/", gse, "/raw_counts_", prefix, ".rds")) 
saveRDS(pf        , paste0("datashare/", gse,         "/pf_", prefix, ".rds"))


```

## Export features


```{r export_feta_bed, results="verbatim"}
library(GenomicRanges)

max_gap = 999   # features separated by less than 1000 bp are merged

# --- Features (one probe per line) ---
gr = GenomicRanges::makeGRangesFromDataFrame(
  pf,
  keep.extra.columns = TRUE,
  seqnames.field = "chr",
  start.field = "start",
  end.field = "end",
  strand.field = "strand"
)
# gr$name = gr$probe
gr = sort(gr)

bed_features = data.frame(
  chrom  = as.character(seqnames(gr)),
  start  = start(gr) - 1,   # BED is 0-based
  end    = end(gr),
  name   = gr$name,
  score  = 0,
  strand = "."
)
write.table(bed_features, file = paste0("features_", prefix, ".bed"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)

# --- Aggregated features (probes closer than max_gap are merged) ---
regions = GenomicRanges::reduce(gr, min.gapwidth = max_gap + 1, ignore.strand = TRUE)

# Number of probes and list of probe names per region
ov = GenomicRanges::findOverlaps(gr, regions, ignore.strand = TRUE)
regions$n_probes = tabulate(subjectHits(ov), nbins = length(regions))
regions$name = paste0(as.character(seqnames(regions)), ":", start(regions), "-", end(regions))
regions$probes = vapply(
  split(gr$name[queryHits(ov)], factor(subjectHits(ov), levels = seq_along(regions))),
  paste, collapse = ",", FUN.VALUE = character(1)
)

summary(width(regions))
table(regions$n_probes)

bed_regions = data.frame(
  chrom  = as.character(seqnames(regions)),
  start  = start(regions) - 1,
  end    = end(regions),
  name   = regions$name,
  score  = regions$n_probes,
  strand = "."
)
write.table(bed_regions, file = paste0("features_merged_", prefix, ".bed"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)

# # Keep the probe -> region mapping for later use (e.g. averaging beta per region)
# saveRDS(regions, "features_epic_merged.rds")

```






## Fingerprint (`raw_counts`)

```{r fingerprint}
data = as.matrix(t(raw_counts))
# Compute cumulative signal fractions for each row
cs = t(apply(data, 1, function(x) cumsum(sort(x)) / sum(x)))

fois = factoi[sapply(factoi, function(fa) {class(e[[fa]])})=="factor"]
for (foi in c("null", fois)) {
  layout(1, respect=TRUE)
  col = as.numeric(e[,foi])
  names(col)=rownames(e)
  matplot(t(cs), type="l", lty=1, col=adjustcolor(col, alpha.f=0.7),
    xlab="Ranked genomic features",
    ylab="Cumulative fraction of signal")
  legend("topleft", col=1:length(levels(e[,foi])), levels(e[,foi]), pch=16, title=foi)
}
```


## CP100M norm counts

```{r norm_counts_cp100m, fig.height=4.5}
norm_counts_cp100m = t(t(raw_counts) / apply(raw_counts, 2, sum) * 100000000)
apply(norm_counts_cp100m, 2, sum)
layout(matrix(1:2, 1), respect=TRUE)
plot(density(norm_counts_cp100m))
plot(density(log2(norm_counts_cp100m+1)))

```

## DESeq2 norm counts


```{r norm_counts_deseq, fig.height=4.5}
if (!all(e$gsm %in% colnames(raw_counts))) {stop("problem gsm vs. colnames(raw_counts)")}
countData = raw_counts[,e$gsm]
colnames(countData) = rownames(e)
colData = e[colnames(countData), ]
# Vérifie que les noms de colonnes correspondent
if (!all(colnames(countData) == rownames(colData))) {stop("probleme data vs. e")}

dds = DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = countData,
  colData = colData,
  design = ~ 1
)

dds = DESeq2::estimateSizeFactors(dds)

norm_counts_deseq = DESeq2::counts(dds, normalized=TRUE)
head(norm_counts_deseq[,1:3])
dim(norm_counts_deseq)

saveRDS(norm_counts_deseq, paste0("norm_counts_deseq_", prefix, ".rds"))

layout(matrix(1:2, 1), respect=TRUE)
plot(density(norm_counts_deseq))
plot(density(log2(norm_counts_deseq+1)))
```


# PCA


```{r pca_norm_counts}

norm_counts = list(
  DESeq2 = norm_counts_deseq, 
  CP100M = norm_counts_cp100m
)

for (k in names(norm_counts)) {
  print(k)
  data = log2(as.matrix(t(norm_counts[[k]]))+1)
  pca = prcomp(data, scale=FALSE)
  v = pca$sdev * pca$sdev
  p = v / sum(v) * 100

  layout(matrix(1:6,2), respect=TRUE)
  # layout(matrix(1:2,1), respect=TRUE)
  barplot(p, ylab="% of variance explained", xlab="components")
  for (i in 1:5) {
    j = i+1
    plot(
      pca$x[,i], pca$x[,j],
      xlab=paste0("PC", i, "(", signif(p[i], 3), "%)"),
      ylab=paste0("PC", j, "(", signif(p[j], 3), "%)"),
      col=1,
      pch=16
    )
  }
  layout(1, respect=TRUE)
  i=1 ; j = i+1
  plot(
    pca$x[,1], pca$x[,j],
    xlab=paste0("PC", i, "(", signif(p[i], 3), "%)"),
    ylab=paste0("PC", j, "(", signif(p[j], 3), "%)"),
    col=adjustcolor(1, alpha.f=0.5),
    main=k,
    pch=16
  )
  text(pca$x[,i], pca$x[,j], rownames(pca$x))

  if (exists("factoi")) {
    fois = factoi[sapply(factoi, function(fa) {class(e[[fa]])})=="factor"]
    if (length(fois)>0) {
      for (foi in fois) {
        layout(matrix(1:6,2), respect=TRUE)
        # layout(matrix(1:2,1), respect=TRUE)
        barplot(p, ylab="% of variance explained", xlab="components")
        cols = as.numeric(e[rownames(pca$x),foi])
        legend("topright", col=1:length(levels(e[,foi])), levels(e[,foi]), pch=16, title=foi, bty="n")
        for (i in 1:5) {
          j = i+1
          plot(
            pca$x[,i], pca$x[,j],
            xlab=paste0("PC", i, "(", signif(p[i], 3), "%)"),
            ylab=paste0("PC", j, "(", signif(p[j], 3), "%)"),
            col=cols,
            pch=16
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```
